text:
Acompañar a a cuerpo dormido,

		acariciar his piel mientras sueñas

		in amar esos años prodigiosos

		in íntima vigilia,

		rememorar ese cuerpo secreto

		of eyes dulces and cause ciega,

		to say love sobre his largos cabellos

		and recorrer audaz the línea divisoria,

		without transgredir his paz ni his silencio.
Of
		"Santuario"

		Antorcha of Paja. Córdoba, 1986
